products.name: InShot AI
products.note: Mobile video editing AI; social content; cross-border data review advised

profile_text.body:
InShot is a mobile video and photo editing application whose website describes it as a tool for empowering creators with advanced editing capabilities. The company positions its product around an easy-to-use interface combined with what it describes as powerful AI tools, and user testimonials on the site highlight features including a materials library, transitions, green screening, music integration, stickers, filters, and picture-in-picture support.

The company's tracked AI product is InShot AI, categorized under video generation and editing, with a note that it is oriented toward mobile video editing and social content creation, and that cross-border data review is advised. No litigation, patent filings, SEC records, or MCP server registrations are associated with InShot in the held facts.
